verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel documents its own business-immigration practice for employers. It describes processing visas for key employees, document maintenance and immigration policy, and partnering with businesses on compliance matters with USCIS and the Department of Labor. That covers the company side of sponsorship in general terms, but the evidence never names the specific H-1B and LCA services the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery and transfer services, LCA preparation and public-access-file compliance, a detailed employer paperwork scope, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: We also partner with businesses navigating government inquiries and compliance matters involving USCIS, the Department of Labor, and Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
